title: objectql: after an install-local DELETE of a package that only extends another package's object, GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME serves the extension's field until a restart; no withdrawal restores the owner's bridged copy
body:
**Filing gate ①:** a measured product defect at a public door. **`reach:`** `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` of a package whose only content is an `objectExtensions` field on another install-local package's object. Afterwards `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` for the extended object still answers `200` with the withdrawn field, until a restart. `GET /api/v1/meta/object` and the data plane no longer carry the field.

**Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `marchtian` · session `session_01QyoWKK9RwUNxBxmevy9Neb`, from the #24070 dev's report (comment 6235628967, out-of-scope finding 1, class a). ⛔ Not a claim; the lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the seat that owns `packages/objectql`'s `bridgeManifestObjectsToMetadataService`, once triage grades it.

## Measured (by the #24070 dev, live; not re-measured by this seat)

- Setup: `os start` from a worktree CLI with `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`, so the real metadata plugin is used. Two packages are installed inline through install-local:
  - package A `com.example.crmlite`, with objects `crmlite_account` and `crmlite_contact`;
  - package B `com.example.crmliteext`, whose only content is an `objectExtensions` field `ext_score` on `crmlite_account`.
- After `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/com.example.crmliteext`:
  - `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crmlite_account` answers `200` with `ext_score`;
  - `GET /api/v1/meta/object` and the data plane no longer carry the field.
- The same answer comes from the base build and from PR #24181's build. The dev also measured it in process at `8418a8f1f`.

## Mechanism (read from source by the dev; anchors re-read by this seat on `origin/main` `cb8756b00`)

- When the extender registers, `bridgeManifestObjectsToMetadataService` (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts:2765`) re-registers the OWNER's metadata-service copy with the merged body. The re-register is allowed by the predicate `ownPreviousCopy` (`:2788`), which is keyed on the owner's `_packageId`.
- No withdrawal restores that copy. PR #24181 (#24070) deliberately withdraws only the copies stamped with the uninstalled package's own id, so it leaves this one alone.

## Family

This is the second member of #24070's family: a metadata-service object copy that the bridge wrote and that does not follow an install-local withdrawal.
- #24070 (PR #24181) covers the uninstalled package's OWN copies.
- This card covers OTHER packages' copies that the uninstalled package's extensions rewrote.

## Done when

- After an install-local DELETE of an extender package, with no restart, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` for each object the package extended serves the owner's body without the withdrawn extension's fields. The listing and the data plane already behave this way.
- A pin covers it in process, either beside the #24070 pin in `packages/cloud-connection` or in `packages/objectql`'s bridge tests.
- Suggested landing, from the dev and not a ruling: the bridge's owner (`packages/objectql`). For example, a manifest-service withdrawal counterpart that re-puts the registry's current definition for every object name the package contributed to.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, at this filing:
- `install-local uninstall objectExtensions extension field still served meta object by-name until restart bridged metadata copy` gave 7 hits: #24070 (open; this family's first member, the control), #23473, #23538, #21576, #8284, #7557 and #7000. None is this defect.
- `package withdrawal stale metadata service copy objectExtensions extender uninstall owner object merged body` gave 5 hits: #24070, #23473, #23630, #21980 and #7557. None is this defect.

Dedupe words: install-local uninstall objectExtensions field still served meta object by-name; extender package withdrawal stale bridged metadata copy; meta/object/NAME serves uninstalled extension field until restart.
